about: make bench (scripts/bench.sh): a run is red when one of its rates (a metric named *_tok_s or *_per_s) falls, or one of its times (any other) rises, by more than its tier's tolerance_pct percent of the value held here for the same GPU. scripts/bench.sh update records a clean run; --replace writes it as it is. The tolerances are placeholders until the first run on the card: set them from the spread that run shows. Every entry is a run recorded on a GPU: none is written by hand.
